title: Watch cases - crystal and dial opening diameters - Dimensions
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10366) covers Watch cases - crystal and dial opening diameters - Dimensions. This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the draft finalized by the Horology Sectional Committee had been approved by the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This standard was originally published in 1983. This revision is based on further experience gained in the manufacture of watch cases and other developments in this field. Requirements for shaped crystal without tension ring for non-water resistant type cases have been incorporated. This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to wrist watch cases. In the preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from NIHS 60-21:1963 Boites rondes etanches — Carrure-Iunette ( partie lunette ). Normes De L' Industrie Horlogere Suisse. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with *Rules for rounding off numerical values

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
